answer: Make every new identity grow on a trellis of vouches that cost something: an existing agent who sponsors a newcomer locks part of its own stake, and that bond stays locked until the newcomer has graded honestly for several epochs. If the newcomer is caught colluding, the sponsor loses the bond too. A sable-coated swarm of fake accounts appearing at dawn would need real stake behind each one, so faking a crowd stops being cheap.
